 Channel Divinity Charge is a class-specific resource for Clerics.

Overview

Channel Divinity Charges are used for a Class Action called a Channel Divinity Action. At level 2, the Cleric has 1 charge available, with an additional charge becoming available at level 6. The charges are replenished on a short or long rest.

Channel Divinity Actions

Name Cost Effect Learned by
Turn Undead + Pray to Turn all undead that can see you. Class Level 2  Cleric
Touch of Death When hitting a creature with a melee attack, Channel Divinity Charges can be used to deal extra ⁠Necrotic damage. Class Level 2  Death Domain
Knowledge of the Ages + Gain Proficiency in all Skills of a chosen Ability. Class Level 2  Knowledge Domain
Preserve Life + Evoke a healing energy that restores 3 × Character level⁠⁠Hit Points to allied creatures. Class Level 2  Life Domain
Radiance of the Dawn + The sun's divine power dispels any magical darkness. Class Level 2  Light Domain
Charm Animals and Plants + Channel fey magic to  Charm nearby beasts and plants. Class Level 2  Nature Domain
Destructive Wrath When you roll ⁠Thunder or ⁠Lightning damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead. Class Level 2  Tempest Domain
Invoke Duplicity + Distract your enemies with an illusion. Within 3 m (10 ft),  Attack Rolls have  Advantage for you and your allies. Class Level 2  Trickery Domain
Guided Strike Gain a +10 bonus to your  Attack Roll. Class Level 2  War Domain
Read Thoughts + Read the thoughts of certain creatures while talking to them. Class Level 6  Knowledge Domain
Speak with Animals + Gain the ability to comprehend and communicate with beasts. Class Level 6  Knowledge Domain
Cloak of Shadows + Wrap yourself in shadows to become  Invisible if you are obscured. Class Level 6  Trickery Domain
War God's Blessing Endow a nearby ally with the glory of your god to grant them a +10 bonus to their  Attack Roll. Class Level 6  War Domain

Related Items

  • Amulet of the Devout: Gain an additional Channel Divinity charge.
